subject: Sponsor invoice schedule and cost-center plan — Bay Area Customer Summit
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave Events <contracts@brightwave.co>, Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor invoice schedule and cost-center plan — Bay Area Customer Summit

Hi team,

Attaching the first vendor invoice from BrightWave for the Bay Area Summit (attached: BrightWave_invoice_0924.pdf). This covers venue deposit and basic AV for the main day. The sponsor (Acme Health / Aisha) has asked for a consolidated invoice schedule so they can align with their AP calendar. Finance also needs a confirmed cost-center mapping before I can route the PO and trigger payment.

Questions I want to resolve this week: 
- Which GL / cost center will we charge for the venue deposit vs. sponsor pass reimbursements? (I attached a draft mapping in CostCenter_Mapping_BAY.xlsx)
- Can we get a one-time P-card exception for the lead event PM to cover small incidental vendor fees (under $1,500 each) until the PO posts?
- If we need a PO, does Finance want a hard PO now or is a PO-less prepayment acceptable with the invoice + DocuSign SOW?

Action requested: Ben, can you confirm the spend cap and whether we can use existing event spend PO 2026-EV-0912 or if you want a new PO? Lauren, confirm if there are any changes to the MOP (attached Sponsor_MOP_BayArea.pdf) that would shift spend categories (e.g., catering guest stipends).

Thanks — I know Acme prefers payments on the 25th of the month so if we can give a schedule to BrightWave by Friday that would keep things aligned.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel | Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightWave_invoice_0924.pdf] [Attachment: Sponsor_MOP_BayArea.pdf] [Attachment: CostCenter_Mapping_BAY.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor invoice schedule and cost-center plan — Bay Area Customer Summit

Monica,

Thanks for the packet and the mapping doc — very helpful. A few notes from finance: 

- We can route the venue deposit and AV to program cost center 400-2100 (Events & Sponsorships). Guest stipends/cash honoraria should be coded to 400-2210 (Speaker/Content). Please update the mapping sheet so the two line items are explicit.
- On the PO: we have an existing umbrella PO (2026-EV-0912) but it's technically at capacity for October. I can raise a new PO if you confirm the total committed spend for BrightWave and whether the deposit will be applied to the final invoice.
- P-card exception: finance policy allows a single-card incidental spend up to $2,000 per month with manager approval; I can sign off for this event provided receipts are submitted within 5 business days.

If you confirm (a) total expected committed spend, (b) whether the deposit is refundable/apply-to-final, and (c) which internal approver will hold receipts for P-card, I will create PO 2026-EV-0987 today and tag it to deal DEAL-8421.

Ben
Ben Carter | Finance Business Partner, GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor invoice schedule and cost-center plan — Bay Area Customer Summit

Thanks — quick ops notes: 
- BrightWave confirmed deposit is non-refundable but will be fully applied to the final invoice.
- We should add a $3,000 line item for guest speaker stipends (confirmed earlier with Acme). Please map those to 400-2210 as Ben recommended.
- Also flagging that we'll need vendor insurance certificate before final payment (BrightWave said they will provide by 10/23).

Monica, if you want me to hold receipts for the P-card, happy to do that. I can also accept digital receipts via Slack or Concur upload.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: BrightWave Events <contracts@brightwave.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 0924 — deposit terms and bank details

Hi Monica / Aisha,

Thanks for confirming the event dates. Per your request: 
- Invoice 0924 is for the venue deposit ($22,500) and AV hold ($4,200) for a subtotal of $26,700. Deposit is non-refundable and will be credited against the final invoice.
- We can provide a certificate of insurance by Friday (10/23).
- Payment terms: wire transfer (preferred) or company P-card. For wire, please remit to: BrightWave Events / ACCT: ****1234 / Routing: 1100000. We will also attach a PDF with remittance details.

If Redwood needs an installment schedule for Acme to attach to their AP, we can provide monthly milestone invoices (deposit + 2x installments). Let us know which cadence works for Acme.

Best,
Cameron Lee
Contracts Manager, BrightWave Events
[Attachment: BrightWave_remit_0924.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmehealth.com>, BrightWave Events <contracts@brightwave.co>

Subject: Re: Sponsor invoice schedule and cost-center plan — Bay Area Customer Summit

Quick summary / agreed actions: 
- Ben will issue PO 2026-EV-0987 for $30,000 (covers deposit + AV + contingency). Finance to confirm when PO is live; Ben to tag DEAL-8421.
- Lauren to collect vendor insurance certificate and confirm guest speaker stipend line item.
- BrightWave will provide remittance PDF and is open to milestone invoices (we will propose deposit + 2 installments to Acme).
- Monica to update CostCenter_Mapping_BAY.xlsx to the two explicit codes Ben provided and upload final sheet to HubSpot.
- P-card exception: Lauren will hold receipts; Ben approved up to $2,000 in incidental charges on P-card with receipts.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421
DocuSign SOW (signed): https://www.docusign.net/ly/ABC123DEF

I'll update the mapping and post the final file by EOD so Ben can generate the PO. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

-Monica
